episodes.title: He Survived a Cult, Worked in Hollywood & Created Cox in Space | Skip Morazi
episodes.description:
In this episode of Fed By Fire, I sit down with Skip Morazi for a conversation that covers everything from the entertainment industry to cult experiences, recovery, and life behind the scenes.

Skip has a story you probably wouldn’t expect. Having lived in Los Angeles, he worked behind the scenes on multiple television productions and developed his own creative project, Cox in Space.

We also get into his experience as a high-functioning autistic person, how he sees and navigates the world, and the experiences that have shaped his life.

But there’s another side to Skip’s story. We discuss his experience inside a cult, how he became involved, what went on behind closed doors, and how that experience eventually intersected with his journey toward rehabilitation.

From Hollywood and television production to surviving a cult and finding a way forward, this conversation covers a lot of ground.

You never really know what someone has been through until you sit down and hear their story.
